name: comic-chat-port
description: TypeScript/PixiJS port of the Comic Chat engine (v1.0-pre reference, v2.5-beta-1 oracle). Phase 3: rulebook + shakedown.

pnpm.//: No dependency needs a postinstall here — vitest gets its esbuild binary from a platform optionalDependency, and the full suite passes with scripts blocked. Keeping the allow-list empty means no third-party install script runs, and silences pnpm's approve-builds prompt in CI.
